paper.title: EmbodiSkill: Skill-Aware Reflection for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
paper.central_claim: 技能感知反思分开skill defect与execution lapse，经body局部修改和appendix强调构成训练无关跨任务技能闭环，比whole-skill更新更有效并保留正确指导。

provenance.notes: 用户指定sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；运行环境声明gpt-6.1-sol，未有独立model receipt/session凭据，不探测；未读他席、其他attempt/批次、aggregate或旧判定。卡内历史结果不作证据。

evidence.quote: A successful trajectory may reveal useful new skill content or a better way to perform an existing skill, but a failed trajectory does not necessarily mean that the current skill is wrong.
evidence.support_explanation: 将所有失败都写回技能会破坏原正确指导，是具体被改变的归因假设；没有量化其发生频率。

evidence.quote: The appendix does not introduce new skill rules; it only highlights existing skill content that should be followed carefully during execution.
evidence.support_explanation: body与appendix权限不同；执行器冻结，F为同一LLM的多prompt调用。

evidence.support_explanation: 单轨迹允许no-op，但可靠性由LLM判断，非独立验证。

evidence.quote: If a signal is misplaced or conflicts cannot be reliably resolved, the model either reassigns it to a more appropriate revision type or discards it, rather than forcing uncertain changes into the skill.
evidence.support_explanation: 存在冲突处理/拒绝编辑分支，非无差别全文重写。

evidence.quote: is kept unchanged in substance. The editor may still perform limited consistency edits, such as removing redundancy, normalizing format, or resolving local conflicts among the affected skill content.
evidence.support_explanation: 未涉区域保留只是prompt约束，缺编辑后独立guard或回滚。

evidence.quote: The appendix update can merge duplicate appendix items, remove obsolete appendix items that no longer correspond to the updated skill body, and incorporate new execution-lapse reflections.
evidence.support_explanation: 有维护/退休操作，但无明确字数上限与操作统计。

evidence.quote: In our split, ALFWorld contains 3,553 training tasks and 134 test tasks; EmbodiedBench-Habitat contains 1,000 training tasks and six test subsets with 50 tasks each; and EmbodiedBench-Navigation contains 1,000 training tasks and five test subsets with 60 tasks each.
evidence.support_explanation: 测试分母明确，success rate任务指标与环境目标相符。

evidence.quote: and perform 10 skill revision stages unless otherwise specified. Training tasks are sampled in randomized order, and the training stream is reshuffled when additional trajectories are required. During test evaluation, the evolved skill is fixed.
evidence.support_explanation: 明确训练轨迹写入/测试只读，但训练可多轮复用；随机顺序未给种子/方差。

evidence.quote: For methods using the same local executor, the executor is kept identical so that performance differences reflect the external skill or memory mechanism rather than changes in the executor.
evidence.support_explanation: 本地同基座对照；teacher计算和memory构建量未匹配。

evidence.quote: With Qwen3.5-27B as the executor and GPT-5.2 as the skill evolution model, the static skill improves over the no-memory setting from 61.19% to 73.13%
evidence.support_explanation: 静态技能baseline实际存在，不把全部提升当自演化。

evidence.quote: Skill-unaware evolution further improves the result to 78.36%, but remains substantially below EmbodiSkill, which reaches 93.28%.
evidence.support_explanation: 14.92pp绝对增益、19.04%相对增益，134测试任务；没有不确定性。

evidence.quote: shows the ALFWorld test success rate across 10 skill revision stages under the Qwen3.5-27B executor and GPT-5.2 skill evolution model.
evidence.support_explanation: 反复查看测试曲线；终版/最佳阶段选取与闭合测试门槛未说明，不能称完全无test selection。
另一skill model增益仅1.49pp，揭示效应依赖teacher/executor；非普适大幅提升。
8B visual Navigation long=0；总体success并不代表长程问题解决。

evidence.quote: On EB-Navigation, EmbodiSkill with Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct reaches the best average score of 61.33% with both GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3-flash as the skill evolution model
evidence.support_explanation: 多模态另一任务域支持可用性，不是同一技能跨harness直接迁移。
